complete_action_rule: Start at episode or sequence boundary; finish the whole action even when the next wall-time interval arrives. Capture terminal state before auto-reset.
duration_source: Actual environment episode_length_s for recovery/roll; declared full sequence duration for transitions; no fixed3second cut.
early_stop_rule: Preserve partial footage and mark it incomplete; never advance extra physics to finish a recording.
historical_frozen_sources: Unchanged. Old3second clips remain original evidence; retrospective full-state replay is labeled separately.
